character.noMoves: No moves available for this character yet.

categoryDescriptions.ground: Basic attacks performed while standing or running
categoryDescriptions.tilt: Gently tilt stick + A (or walk/crouch then A). Faster, weaker — great for combos
categoryDescriptions.smash: Quickly flick stick to max + A at the same time (💡 You can lightly flick stick before one frame, then quickly press A to create the effect). Slower, powerful KO moves. Can be charged by holding A
categoryDescriptions.aerial: Attacks performed while airborne (You can use X or Y for jump)
categoryDescriptions.special: Unique character moves using the B button
categoryDescriptions.other: Ledge attacks, getup attacks, combos, and Final Smash

inputTypes.Tilt: Gently tilt stick + press A (don't flick!)
inputTypes.Smash: Flick stick hard + press A at the same time (can charge by holding A)
